title: AGENTS.md services row still has the package-creating PR amend the ADR status line, against ruling B (ADR edits leave implementation cards)
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① documentation defect with a named producer, raised at ACCEPT of PR #32486 (#32179, ruling record 6797014134 letter B). ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## The text

`AGENTS.md` Context Routing, the `packages/services/**` row (L728 on `main`): a package name in an ADR is a proposal; where the tree's precedent differs, "the PR that creates the package follows the precedent and amends that ADR's status line in the same change".

## Why it now reads wrong

Ruling 6797014134 (B): an implementation card's file surface excludes `docs/adr/**`; the ADR bookkeeping line is filed by the landing seat after the code merges, citing the merge commit. PR #32486 puts that rule into the pm-dispatch references. The AGENTS.md row still tells the package-creating PR to edit the ADR in the same change. `AGENTS.md` was outside #32486's file surface.

## Reach

Every dev that creates a package under `packages/services/**` or the row above it, and the seat that lands it.

## Duplicate check

Carried as `carrier: the domain:skills seat` in PR #32486's Acceptance notes and in review 6811091643 ③; no open card.
